audience: Second year electronics students who finished DC circuit analysis. This course is a sprint 1 pipeline test, so it starts small.

lessons.title: The Common-Emitter Amplifier
lessons.summary: Bias a BJT, build the small-signal model and compute voltage gain.
objectives: Explain why the emitter is common to input and output
Compute the DC bias point of a voltage divider biased BJT
Compute small-signal voltage gain with $A_v = -g_m R_C$
Predict what happens to gain when the emitter is unbypassed
lessons.plannedFigures: No external figure files in this run. The Figure maker is not part of sprint 1. Use the Mermaid component for a signal path diagram if it helps.
lessons.plannedPractice: One worked DC bias example, one worked gain example, one NumericQuiz on bias and one Quiz on gain behavior.
